title: Kenshi shared state 0.4
description: Engine-neutral snapshot of loaded characters and their squads/factions. No wall clock, process identity, address, or adapter metadata belongs in this state. Collections sort lexically by stable ID; numbers use the six-decimal canonical encoding documented in protocol.md. Version 0.2 adds producer-asserted identity provenance, nullable combat mode and proven town-placement/squad-template context; null is unknown coverage. Version 0.3 adds the nullable slave state and slave owner faction of each character; null is unknown coverage, never not_slave or no owner. Version 0.4 adds the nullable medical state, stored stat values, use-stuff state, carrying and being-carried state of each character, bandage, splint and wear of each health part, and the money of each squad; null is unknown coverage, never 0, false, nothing or an empty object.

id.description: Opaque persistent save/data identity, never a memory address or an enumeration index.

position.description: Absolute world coordinates x, y, z; y is height. Never camera-relative coordinates.

day.description: Zero-based world day, not the one-based UI day.

hour.description: Hour within the world day. The value 24 is permitted only for rounding of an observation immediately before midnight.

elapsed_seconds.description: Absolute calendar seconds since world time origin: total world hours multiplied by 3600. Not wall time, QPC, or engine simulation seconds. Per MeitouClient's constant of 1200/11 simulated seconds per in-game hour, one simulated second is 33 calendar seconds; this conversion is measured on MeitouClient (checkpoint tick steps); on the original the engine reports the same hour length, simulated-time equivalence argued.

speed.description: Effective game speed, observed as zero while paused. The remembered nonzero selection is not exposed by the public game API and does not belong in this common state.

id.description: Body-part data identity followed by :neither, :left, :right, or :both where the adapter uses side to distinguish parts.

current.description: Current flesh/structural health, including negative health.

bandage.description: Stored bandaging amount of this part (the original HealthPartStatus bandaging member). null means unavailable; it never means 0 or unbandaged.

splint.description: Stored splint (jury-rigging) amount of this part (the original juryRigging member). null means unavailable; it never means 0 or no splint.

wear.description: Stored wear damage of this part (the original wearDamage member). null means unavailable; it never means 0.

type.description: Stable symbolic task name, lower-case public task enumeration name; no numeric C++ enum value.

health.description: All readable body parts, or null when coverage is unavailable/incomplete; [] means a known empty set.

order.description: Current task, or null if absent/unavailable. Coverage documentation records which interpretation is possible.

current_town_id.description: Stable town-placement identity shared by both producers only when equivalence is proven. Never a TOWN definition id, transient HAND, display name, nearest-town guess or array index. Null unless town_assignment is inside.

town_assignment.description: inside means the engine establishes membership in the identified town placement; outside means a known absence of town membership; null means unavailable or unproven coverage. Null must not be interpreted as outside.

in_combat.description: The broad combat-mode predicate including both melee and ranged participation (the original isInCombatMode(true,true), or a proven equivalent). False means the predicate is known false; null means unavailable or not semantically verified. It is not inferred from the current task, health or target alone.

slave_state.description: The character's slave state, named after the original SlaveStateEnum (NOT_SLAVE, IS_SLAVE, ESCAPING_SLAVE, EX_SLAVE). null means unavailable or a raw engine value outside that enumeration; it never means not_slave. Worn or locked shackles, cage or prisoner use and chained mode are not part of this field.

slave_owner_faction_id.description: Faction data identity (the same GameData stringID namespace as factions[].id) of the faction that owns this character as a slave, when readable. null means no owner faction is readable; it does not prove that the character has no owner. Not a display name, address or index.

medical.description: Medical state, or null when the medical system is unavailable. Never an empty object.

stats.description: Stored stats, or null when the character has no stats object. Never an empty object.

in_something.description: Use-stuff state named after the original UseStuffState (IN_NOTHING, IN_BED, IN_PRISON). null means unavailable or a raw engine value outside that enumeration; it never means nothing.

carrying.description: What the character carries: nothing (known not carrying), character (a carried character, identified by carrying_id), other (a carried object that is not a character), or null when unavailable. null never means nothing.

carrying_id.description: Identity of the carried character, canonicalized like order.target_id. A string exactly when carrying is character; null otherwise.

being_carried.description: Whether another character carries this character. false means known false; null means unavailable.

members.description: Loaded member identities in this snapshot, sorted lexically.

template_id.description: The stable SQUAD_TEMPLATE or UNIQUE_SQUAD_TEMPLATE data identity used to create the squad, when established. Not a squad instance id or display name; null when unknown.

origin_town_id.description: Proven original/home town-placement identity, using exactly the same identity namespace as current_town_id. Never a town definition id or name. Null means unknown or no established origin; it does not establish current presence in that town.

money.description: Money of the squad (the original Platoon ownerships money), or null when unavailable; null never means 0.

value.description: Directional source-to-target relation, or null when unavailable. Do not mirror it to the reverse direction.

identity_origin.description: Producer-proven identity origin: saved means a complete saved identity was linked to this loaded entity; generated means creation outside the source save is independently established; null means unknown. Absence of a resolved saved identity never proves generation.

coma.description: Coma flag (the original sub50KO member). false means known false; null means unavailable.

blood_loss_trauma.description: Blood-loss knockout flag (the original bloodlossTrauma member). false means known false; null means unavailable.

stats.description: Exactly the 34 stored stat values, keyed by the KenshiLib StatsEnumerated name without STAT_ in lower case. Each is the stored value (no multiplier and no effective-stat formula), or null when unavailable; null never means 0. hivemedic and vet (stored as medic), weapons and survival are not keys.
